settings.question: How long are packages valid?
settings.answer: Essential packages are valid for 6 months, Premium packages for 1 year, and Elite memberships are ongoing monthly subscriptions that can be cancelled anytime.

settings.question: Can I share my package with family or friends?
settings.answer: Yes! Package sessions can be transferred to immediate family members. Please contact us to coordinate.

settings.question: What if I need to cancel my membership?
settings.answer: Elite memberships can be cancelled at any time with 30 days notice. No cancellation fees apply.

settings.question: Can I apply my package to any treatment?
settings.answer: Yes! Package sessions can be used for any of our standard treatments. Some specialty treatments may require an additional fee.
